card.name: Words just before MAO inhibitor mentions
card.fires_on: Small linking words or verbs right before a MAO inhibitor (MAOI) is named, in contraindication text about taking or stopping one. Examples are 'an', 'with', 'taking', 'stopping,' and 'discontinuing'.
